%% A token-bucket rate limiter: the decision flow for one request.
flowchart TB
  req([Request arrives]) --> key[Build key: user id + route]
  key --> get[(Read bucket from Redis)]
  get --> has{Bucket exists?}
  has -->|no| create[Create bucket with full tokens]
  has -->|yes| refill[Refill tokens for the time passed]
  create --> check
  refill --> check{Tokens left?}
  check -->|yes| take[Take one token]
  check -->|no| reject[Reply 429 Too Many Requests]:::red
  take --> save[(Write bucket back, with a TTL)]
  save --> pass([Forward to the service]):::green
  reject --> hdr[Set the Retry-After header]
  note for check: Token bucket: 100 tokens, refills 10 per second
  note for save: A Lua script makes the read and the write atomic
